long_biography.plain_text:
TAIF became the central business institution in Radik Mintimerovich Shaimiev's career. Trained as a civil engineer, the Russian businessman joined other founders in acquiring much of the Tatarstan holding's asset base during the mid-1990s. Refineries, chemical plants and power generation formed the industrial core from which his private fortune developed.

The group's 2021 combination with SIBUR changed Shaimiev's relationship to those assets. Eight TAIF owners transferred the holding's petrochemical and energy businesses, receiving shares in the combined company and long-dated bonds in return. The deal consolidated TAIF's major chemical businesses inside SIBUR and converted Shaimiev's former holding-company stake into a minority investment in a larger petrochemical group.
